main.remarks: Declares manifest identity metadata for a custom tool-operations schema.

property.name: ToolSchemaID
property.summary: Gets the schema identifier to publish for the annotated tool.

property.name: AccessKeyRealmID
property.summary: Gets or sets the access-key realm identifier to publish for the annotated tool.

property.name: ToolSchemaVersion
property.summary: Gets or sets the schema version to publish for the annotated tool.

property.name: CompanionNamespace
property.summary: Gets or sets an optional namespace override for the generated companion manifest class.
property.remarks: When omitted, the generated companion class uses the annotated tool type's containing namespace.

property.name: CompanionTypeName
property.summary: Gets or sets an optional type-name override for the generated companion manifest class.
property.remarks: When omitted, the generated companion class name falls back to the annotated tool type name with the standard manifest companion suffix.
